University of Kentucky administrator and nontheistic Humanist David Durman secured a religious exemption to abstain from workplace AI use.

Assisted by the American Humanist Association, Durman cited concerns over critical thinking, livelihoods, and environmental costs.

The university confirmed he could be accommodated while maintaining essential job functions.
